verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no natural-language command interface for operating Sentry. Seer is described as a debugging agent that finds root causes and generates patches, not as a way to run the product through natural-language commands. The setup prompt relies on external coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code), which is a user-side workaround, and Agent Tracing monitors other agents rather than letting users command Sentry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
